title: Looks Nice but a Little too Fragile
text:
Looks Nice but a Little too Fragile. We drink lots of tea in our household. Making tea with ordinary tea bags is usually good enough, but lately we have taken a liking to loose leaf tea. And a means to make and serve larger servings of loose leaf tea is the MIOCARO Glass Tea Pot Warmer Set.

Glass in design with a metal base, this teapot holds one liter of tea, so it is good for about 5 cups of tea, depending on serving size. There is a metal insert in the center where you place your loose leaf tea. You then pour in hot water, let it steep, and serve. The metal base holds the teapot and serves as a warmer, since you can place a small light or short candle underneath, to keep your tea warm.

This glass tea pot looks nice and I like the warmer idea, but I have several concerns. My greatest issue, straight from the box, is the fragility of the tea pot and the way it perches on the metal base. The glass doesn’t seem very heavy and it sits on the base on a wobbly fashion. I think if the base had been designed to be a little deeper, it would make me feel better. One slight bump and the teapot will fall of the base, may crack, and have to be discarded. With the pot filled with tea, the added weight makes it a little sturdier, but I still don’t feel that safe.

The other issue I have with this tea pot is that the warmer base almost looks like it was intended to be used directly on your stovetop burner. It isn’t so make sure you don’t use it in this manner. The true intention is to use the base as a countertop warmer by placing a small light or candle in the opening below the pot. I only confirmed this by first inquiring online.

I drink more tea than any other beverage. MIOCARO Glass Tea Pot Warmer Set is a good addition to my kitchen overall and it does brew a good pot of tea. I am still concerned that its fragile nature means it won’t last very long and for that reason, I can only rate it average overall.
